Character sprites extracted from Namaiki Delation (ナマイキデレーション).

Due to the large number of character sprites and expression variants,
the complete character sprite collection has been divided into three galleries.

This gallery is Part 1 of 3.
The remaining character sprites are included in Parts 2 and 3.

从《ナマイキデレーション（Namaiki Delation）》
游戏资源中提取的人物立绘。

由于本作人物立绘及表情差分数量较多，
完整的人物立绘合集分为三个画廊上传。

本画廊为人物立绘合集第一卷，共三卷。
其余人物立绘收录于第二卷和第三卷。
